claim: Detecting whether a rebuild read the implementation it verifies can be done by substring search over its source.

environment.what: a validator checking that a doc-derived rebuild does not import the reference module

witness.expect: the AST-based check rejects a rebuild that imports the reference and accepts one that merely names it in a docstring
witness.negative_control: the substring version rejected the legitimate rebuild, which is how the attempt failed

applies_until: Always available as an option: substring search may be adequate where docstrings and sibling filenames cannot contain the stem. It failed here, not everywhere.

cost.to_discover: one false positive on the first run
